purpose: Define the Expose Portfolio Editor as a MetaModule projection/editor over PortfolioCore entries and evidence links, with all mutations performed through explicit authorized canonical operations.

topics.name: Portfolio Editor
topics.purpose: Define the Expose Portfolio Editor as a MetaModule projection/editor over PortfolioCore entries and evidence links, with all mutations performed through explicit authorized canonical operations.

semantics.edit_rule: Create/update/remove operations target exact PortfolioCore identities.
semantics.verification_rule: Editor cannot mark evidence verified without the explicit verification operation/evidence required by policy.
semantics.merit_rule: Editor cannot directly edit MeritCore points/Tier/trust/recommendations.
semantics.authority_rule: Editor has no AC bypass and uses normal AccessCore authorization.
semantics.self_rule: UI layout/navigation remains nanoCMS/MetaModule composition rather than PortfolioCore semantics.

invariants.rule: PortfolioCore represents explicit identity-linked references and evidence metadata; it never manufactures competence, merit, trust or authorization from presentation content.

hard_gates.condition: Portfolio Editor directly edits MeritCore values
UI marks evidence verified without verification operation
UI layout becomes PortfolioCore semantic ownership

references.purpose: Portfolio Editor is a normal MetaModule.
Editor projects/edits PortfolioCore through explicit operations.
